purpose: Freeze a project-owned lifecycle for the protected shared Qwen chat and 1024-dimensional embedding services needed by all matched Mem-Gallery runs, without starting either service while WMA Wave1 is active.
scientific_question: Can every future Mem-Gallery method use the same hash-verified answer and shared embedding services with exact endpoints, accelerator topology, health checks, process ownership, and terminal stop evidence?
estimand_boundary: This is service identity and lifecycle evidence only. It estimates no memory-method quality, does not read a benchmark example, and cannot establish a comparison or SOTA claim.

protected_models.runtime_validation: Before creating the service root, rehash every one of the 38 signed model files, require the exact two signed placement/inventory files per model, reject every extra file or symlink, and recompute the two snapshot identities.
protected_models.observation_role: The 2026-09-04 read-only count/hash observation binds current small manifests only. It is not a substitute for the future complete runtime rehash.

release_and_fresh_root_gate.root: An absent non-symlink exact child of an existing exact AgentEnhance/runs directory.

chat.image_capacity_rationale: At most 20 registered memory images plus one question image.

readiness.accepted_models_response: Exactly one OpenAI model object with the role-specific served-model id.
readiness.chat_smoke: One non-benchmark temperature-zero request with nonempty content and exact additive token usage.
readiness.embedding_smoke: One non-benchmark request returning exactly one ordered finite nonzero 1024-dimensional vector and exact prompt/total usage.

ownership_and_stop.process_identity: Each ready role binds its positive PID, isolated PGID=PID, live /proc command-line SHA-256, exact command SHA-256, GPU mapping, endpoint, models response, and smoke response.
ownership_and_stop.pre_signal_revalidation: Reload and validate the entire ready receipt, exact commands, role/model identities, models-response hashes and contents, smoke-request/response hashes and contents, then revalidate every live PID/PGID/cmdline before signaling.
ownership_and_stop.initial_signal: SIGTERM to only the exact owned process group
ownership_and_stop.fallback_signal: SIGKILL to the same exact owned process group only after timeout
ownership_and_stop.postcondition: Both PIDs are absent and ports 18320 and 18321 bind free.

evidence_protocol.startup_failure: Attempt ownership-checked cleanup for every process created by this invocation, retain and sign every durable file created, add service-failure.json, and mark TERMINAL_REJECTED.
evidence_protocol.stop_failure: Attempt both roles even if one fails, retain successful stop outcomes and exact errors, sign service-stop-failure.json with the ready evidence, and mark TERMINAL_REJECTED.

covered_invariants: complete signed model snapshot rehash and file tamper rejection
exact two-service launch profiles and multimodal image capacity
models and smoke response parsing with zero/nonfinite rejection
active Wave1 denial before root creation
root collision denial before model rehash or GPU observation
two-process ready lifecycle with four diagnostic HTTP calls
startup exit cleanup plus signed retained failure evidence
two-process ownership-validated terminal stop with twelve signed files
one-role ownership failure while still attempting the other role

next_gate: After Wave1 terminal acceptance, use the accepted release receipt to run this exact service lifecycle only as part of a separately frozen result-free Mem-Gallery adapter-family lifecycle or numerical controller. Combine it with accepted dataset integrity, the NaiveRAG parity branch, and method-specific model receipts before any 42-run authorization.
authorization: This implementation freeze authorizes no current model rehash, service start, GPU allocation, endpoint request, dataset access, prediction, score, comparison, claim, cleanup, or table mutation.
